confidence_rationale: Strong HFO consensus on LG8 and RC5, and ictal detection with high peak probability in two segments (119-132.5s and 136.5-199s) support confidence. However, cross-modal mismatch warning limits integration confidence.

hfo_assessment.summary: High HFO activity with 246 total FR events and 18 FR+DR pairs detected across 89 epochs.

seizure_assessment.ictal_detection_summary: Two ictal segments detected at 119-132.5s (22 positive windows, 0.88 peak prob) and 136.5-199s (120 positive windows, 0.91 peak prob).
seizure_assessment.summary: Seizure evidence supported by model-derived saliency proxy with top channels showing high ictal probability.

integration_assessment.summary: Cross-modal mismatch warning indicates no direct overlap between HFO and seizure supportive channels, limiting integration confidence.

limitations: No exact channel overlap for integration
Seizure channel evidence is model-derived saliency proxy rather than direct electrophysiological localization.
No direct cross-modal overlap was identified between HFO and seizure supportive channels.

ez_hypothesis.summary: Insufficient channel overlap to determine epileptogenic zone hypothesis.
